# R03 IsOS control-grant handoff cases

[中文](README_cn.md) · [IsOS owner contract](../../../../../docs/isos/interfaces/cores/control-grants.md) · [Design](../../../../../docs/isos/design/server.md)

`cases.json` is the frozen design matrix for IsOS issuance and launch delivery. It is not a passing-runtime claim. A clean `ISOS_HOME`, an explicitly selected verified schema-2 V2 graph generation, a required selected EOS stub, and optional selected EGIA and bridge stubs form the baseline. Each stub records only the *names* of reserved environment variables it sees. The EOS R03 suite independently checks verifier bytes, gRPC metadata, role/method scopes and Dispatcher release. No fixture writes a real grant into a source checkout.

Positive cases establish exact file format/mode, all three paths when all roles are selected, EOS-plus-config without EGIA/bridge and no-bridge launches, one verifier bound to saved revision and run ID, idempotent Start and automatic child restart reuse, same-revision explicit Restart rotation, and recovery after failed replacement using another new run. Negative cases inject unsafe files, malformed grant/verifier, changed revision, required EOS omitted from the candidate plan before stop, missing P04 snapshot, a `0.1.0` G03 or absent V2 selection, an old `1.0.0` graph, authored `--run-id` and `--run-id=...`, and a synthetic random-source failure. A rejection before replacement must leave active PIDs, revision and bundle intact and emit a manager-session `deployment_preflight_failed` without changing the previous P07 current-run scope. A selected grant injection failure after `deployment_starting` belongs to the candidate run, has its terminal failure event, and cannot promise unchanged old PIDs; recovery uses a distinct run. A failed replacement must terminate its candidate run; old credentials cannot authorize recovery. Stop retires the bundle after reaping recipients. Status, API errors and JSONL events contain only sanitized codes, run IDs and revisions, never a grant, its digest or bearer text.

Half-managed EOS launches with only the selected profile or only the verifier fail before listener bind. Neither input means standalone read-only, even if `--run-id` is present. R03-I26 rejects a selected older EOS executable lacking the exact `managed-control-grants` feature during P05 preflight, before child stop or grant issuance.

The implementation runner must map each `id` to a unit or clean-home boundary test, record the command, selected EOS/IsOS commits and result under ignored `logs/test/<run-id>/`, then obtain independent review. Run `python3 tests/fixtures/control_grants/check_cases.py` to validate the design matrix and bilingual links.
